title: Microgen TUI workspace comparison
brief: Compare the validated TView dashboard with three terminal-native workflows for editing services, entities, and fields.

artboards.title: Current layout reference
artboards.tradeoff: Keeps the file plan visible; editing changes context through separate managers.

artboards.title: Tree + properties (recommended)
artboards.tradeoff: Preserves service and entity context across edits; adds a pane and focus model to learn.

artboards.title: List + focused editor
artboards.tradeoff: One clear edit target; sibling entities disappear while editing at 80 columns.

artboards.title: Guided workspace
artboards.tradeoff: Explains what to do next; slower for frequent cross-service edits.
